description: This file defines the ModelMenuCondition class, which models a <condition> element within a widget menu in the OFBiz framework. It encapsulates attributes like pass-style and disabled-style, and associates a condition object.

classes.name: ModelMenuCondition
classes.description: Implements an immutable model representing a <condition> element in a widget menu, holding style expanders and an associated condition.

methods.name: ModelMenuCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes style expanders and the condition object based on an XML element.

methods.name: getFailStyleExdr
methods.description: Returns the flexible string expander for the fail/disabled style.

methods.name: getPassStyleExdr
methods.description: Returns the flexible string expander for the pass style.
